stem.en: The new medicine ___ to be very effective.

why.en: People believe it, so we use the reporting passive: subject + is believed + to-infinitive.
why.uz: Bunga odamlar ishonadi, shuning uchun majhul nisbatli xabar qolipi: ega + is believed + to-infinitiv.
why.ru: В это верят люди, поэтому пассивная конструкция: подлежащее + is believed + инфинитив с to.

stem.en: It ___ that the company will open a new office in Fergana.

why.en: It + passive reporting verb + that-clause: It is rumoured that...
why.uz: It + majhul nisbatdagi xabar feʼli + that-gap: It is rumoured that...
why.ru: It + глагол сообщения в пассиве + that-придаточное: It is rumoured that...

stem.en: The thieves are thought ___ the city last night.

why.en: The leaving happened before now (last night), so we need the perfect infinitive: to have left.
why.uz: Ketish hozirdan oldin boʻlgan (last night), shuning uchun perfekt infinitiv kerak: to have left.
why.ru: Уход был раньше (last night), поэтому нужен перфектный инфинитив: to have left.

stem.en: She is said ___ on a new novel at the moment.

why.en: At the moment shows an action in progress: is said + to be + -ing.
why.uz: At the moment davom etayotgan harakatni bildiradi: is said + to be + -ing.
why.ru: At the moment указывает на длящееся действие: is said + to be + -ing.

stem.en: I ___ to buy a ticket, so I saved some money. The concert was free.

why.en: Didn't need to = it was not necessary (and I didn't do it); needn't have is not followed by to.
why.uz: Didn't need to = kerak boʻlmadi (va qilmadim); needn't have dan keyin to kelmaydi.
why.ru: Didn't need to = не было нужно (и я не стал); после needn't have не ставится to.

stem.en: Don't worry, she's ___ to call you back. She always does.

why.uz: Be bound to + feʼl biror narsa deyarli aniq sodir boʻlishini bildiradi.
why.ru: Be bound to + глагол означает, что что-то почти наверняка произойдёт.

stem.en: You ___ told me the meeting was cancelled! I waited for an hour.

why.en: Could have + past participle criticises something that was possible but not done.
why.uz: Could have + uchinchi shakl qilinishi mumkin boʻlgan, lekin qilinmagan ish uchun tanqidni bildiradi.
why.ru: Could have + третья форма — упрёк: это можно было сделать, но не сделали.

stem.en: Take a coat. It ___ well get cold later.

why.en: May well + verb means it is quite likely: it may well get cold.
why.uz: May well + feʼl ancha ehtimolli ekanini bildiradi: it may well get cold.
why.ru: May well + глагол — это вполне вероятно: it may well get cold.

stem.en: She looked at me as though I ___ mad.

why.en: As though + an unreal comparison takes a past form: as though I were mad.
why.uz: As though + haqiqatga toʻgʻri kelmaydigan qiyos oʻtgan zamon shaklini oladi: as though I were mad.
why.ru: As though + нереальное сравнение требует формы прошедшего: as though I were mad.

stem.en: If only I ___ to my parents' advice last year!

why.en: If only about the past (last year) takes the past perfect: had listened.
why.uz: Oʻtmish haqidagi If only (last year) Past Perfect bilan keladi: had listened.
why.ru: If only о прошлом (last year) требует Past Perfect: had listened.

stem.en: But for your help, I ___ the exam.

why.en: But for = if it hadn't been for; about a past result we use would have + past participle.
why.uz: But for = if it hadn't been for; oʻtmishdagi natija uchun would have + uchinchi shakl.
why.ru: But for = if it hadn't been for; для результата в прошлом — would have + третья форма.

stem.en: ___ the delay, the flight landed safely.

why.en: Notwithstanding (= despite) + noun shows contrast; owing to gives a reason, which does not fit.
why.uz: Notwithstanding (= despite) + ot qarama-qarshilikni bildiradi; owing to sabab bildiradi, mos emas.
why.ru: Notwithstanding (= despite) + существительное выражает контраст; owing to — причина, не подходит.

why.ru: После albeit (= although) может идти группа прилагательного без глагола.
